changelog:
## v1.0.3– Security Hardening

- Restricted API requests to approved Microsoft Graph hosts and Intune/Entra endpoint areas.
- Prevented bearer tokens from being printed to stdout.
- Added enforced confirmation flags for write operations.
- Tier 3 actions now require the exact confirmed object name.
- Preserved strict read-only mode for all non-GET requests.
- Improved token-cache permissions and secret handling.
- Fixed compatibility with macOS Bash 3.2.
- Corrected license ownership information.
- Updated security documentation and usage examples.
